businessLogic.rawSource:
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
WWPBaseObjects.LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_STATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA'
		Do 'LoadStatementOfIncomeCuentaOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_STATEMENTOFINCOMESUM'
		Do 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSumOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_STATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT'
		Do 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSubstractOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"DB.StatementOfIncomeWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMECUENTA_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUM_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFSTATEMENTOFINCOMESUBSTRACT_SEL"
				&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadStatementOfIncomeCuentaOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta = &SearchTxt
	&TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.StatementOfIncome
		Order StatementOfIncomeCuenta
		using StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		Option Distinct
		If not StatementOfIncomeCuenta.IsEmpty()
			&Option = StatementOfIncomeCuenta
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSumOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFStatementOfIncomeSum = &SearchTxt
	&TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each StatementOfIncome
		Order StatementOfIncomeSum
		using StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each StatementOfIncome
			Order StatementOfIncomeSum
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not StatementOfIncomeSum.IsEmpty()
			&Option = StatementOfIncomeSum
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadStatementOfIncomeSubstractOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract = &SearchTxt
	&TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each StatementOfIncome
		Order StatementOfIncomeSubstract
		using DB.StatementOfIncomeWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta, &TFStatementOfIncomeCuenta_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum, &TFStatementOfIncomeSum_Sel, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract
					, &TFStatementOfIncomeSubstract_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each StatementOfIncome
			Order StatementOfIncomeSubstract
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not StatementOfIncomeSubstract.IsEmpty()
			&Option = StatementOfIncomeSubstract
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
